Troubleshooting

Thank you for bringing up the issue. To resolve error code 7, we need to reboot the charger, which should resolve the problem. If the issue persists and error code 3 appears afterwards, we will need to perform a manual fast shutdown activity. Currently, upon inspection, there are no issues with the charger, and all outlets are available. One of the outlets is currently charging a vehicle. Please inform me if you require further information for discussion. If not, we will proceed with closing this ticket.
For future reference, your ticket number is
0382863
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
